    """
    # =====================================================================
    # EXPERIMENT DEFINITION
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Research Question:
    #   Does Formulation A alter cell viability relative to Formulation B
    #   when both are applied at the same dose to identically seeded cells?
    #
    # Estimand:
    #   Delta = mean(viability | Formulation A) - mean(viability | Formulation B)
    #   * Population : cells seeded 1:1 from source_plate into destination_plate
    #   * Treatment  : single 20 uL dose of Formulation A (trough A1) or
    #                  Formulation B (trough A2)
    #   * Replication: 48 wells per formulation, block-randomized within each
    #                  plate column (4 A + 4 B per column) so column-wise
    #                  gradients cancel out of the A-vs-B contrast
    #   * Endpoint   : viability signal measured downstream; Delta estimated
    #                  with a linear model adjusting for plate column
    # =====================================================================

    # --- 1. Retrieve pre-configured deck resources -----------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagent_trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- 2. Experimental parameters ---------------------------------------
    ROWS = "ABCDEFGH"
    COLS = range(1, 13)
    SEED_VOL = 20.0   # uL cell suspension per well
    FORM_VOL = 20.0   # uL formulation per well (safe for 50 uL tips)
    MIX_VOL = 30.0    # uL mixing volume (< 40 uL final well content)

    # Tip consumption plan: 12 (seeding) + 24 (formulation blocks) = 36 tips
    # Each spot in the 96-position rack is used at most once.
    tip_spots = [f"{row}{col}" for row in ROWS for col in COLS]
    tip_iter = iter(tip_spots)

    # --- 3. Block-randomized treatment allocation -------------------------
    # Assumption: each source well holds a homogeneous cell suspension.
    # Fixed seed => the randomization is reproducible for the record.
    random.seed(42)
    wells_a_by_col = {}
    wells_b_by_col = {}
    for col in COLS:
        column = [f"{row}{col}" for row in ROWS]
        random.shuffle(column)
        wells_a_by_col[col] = sorted(column[:4], key=lambda w: ROWS.index(w[0]))
        wells_b_by_col[col] = sorted(column[4:], key=lambda w: ROWS.index(w[0]))

    # Report the randomized layout so it can be joined to the readout data
    print("Randomized layout (formulation -> wells):")
    for col in COLS:
        print(f"  Col {col:>2}: A={wells_a_by_col[col]} B={wells_b_by_col[col]}")

    # --- 4. Seed cells: 1:1 transfer, source plate -> treatment plate -----
    # A fresh tip per column keeps any cell-density drift within-column only,
    # so it cannot bias the between-formulation contrast.
    for col in COLS:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[next(tip_iter)])
        for row in ROWS:
            well = f"{row}{col}"
            await lh.aspirate(source_plate[well], vols=[SEED_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(destination_plate[well], vols=[SEED_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()

    # --- 5. Apply formulations, alternating A/B per column ----------------
    # Which formulation is dispensed first within each column block is
    # randomized, balancing time-dependent effects across both arms.
    for col in COLS:
        blocks = [
            ("A1", "Formulation A", wells_a_by_col[col]),
            ("A2", "Formulation B", wells_b_by_col[col]),
        ]
        random.shuffle(blocks)  # randomize dispense order within column

        for trough_well, label, targets in blocks:
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[next(tip_iter)])

            # Pre-wet tip to minimize adsorption-driven volume variability
            await lh.aspirate(reagent_trough[trough_well], vols=[FORM_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(reagent_trough[trough_well], vols=[FORM_VOL])

            for well in targets:
                await lh.aspirate(reagent_trough[trough_well], vols=[FORM_VOL])
                await lh.dispense(destination_plate[well], vols=[FORM_VOL])
                # Homogenize dose with cells (30 uL mix < 50 uL tip capacity)
                await lh.mix(destination_plate[well], vols=[MIX_VOL], mixes=3)

            await lh.drop_tips()

    # --- 6. Plate ready for incubation and viability readout --------------
    print("Treatment plate prepared:")
    print("  96 wells seeded (20 uL) + dosed (20 uL), mixed 3x")
    print("  Formulation A: 48 wells | Formulation B: 48 wells, column-balanced")
    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

    """
    # FIXED: use LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend instead of deprecated ChatterBoxBackend.
    # FIXED: removed unsupported `deck_layout=None` argument.

    # [AGENT_CODE_STUB]
    # ==================================================================

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Independent variable : TREATMENT (factor with 2 levels)
    #   * Treatment group  : sample + treatment reagent (trough A1)
    #   * Control group    : sample + vehicle solvent   (trough A2)
    #                        -> vehicle control isolates the compound
    #                           effect from solvent-only effects.
    # Dependent variable   : endpoint measured later on destination_plate.
    # Confounding factors operationalized / controlled:
    #   1. Edge/evaporation effects -> ALL non-experimental wells filled
    #      with buffer (moat + humidity uniformity); experiment confined
    #      to the inner 6x10 region (rows B-G, cols 2-11).
    #   2. Spatial bias  -> treatment/control assignment randomized
    #      (seeded, reproducible) across the plate.
    #   3. Order/time bias -> every phase processed in randomized order;
    #      treatment & vehicle additions interleaved so both groups
    #      experience identical timing drift.
    #   4. Carry-over contamination -> fresh tip per reagent transfer;
    #      a sample tip only touches its own well pair; no tip ever
    #      enters both a treatment and a control well.
    #   5. Volume variability -> fixed, identical volumes in both groups.
    #   6. Row/block gradients -> rows act as blocks; both groups are
    #      present across the inner region.
    # ==================================================================
    import random

    random.seed(42)  # reproducible randomization

    # ---- resource handles ---------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # ---- factor levels (reagent trough channels) -----------------------
    TREATMENT_CH = "A1"   # treatment reagent (factor level 1)
    VEHICLE_CH = "A2"     # vehicle control   (factor level 2)
    BUFFER_CH = "A3"      # blank buffer for moat / humidity wells

    # ---- fixed volumes (uL) --------------------------------------------
    SAMPLE_VOL = 15    # sample plated into every experimental well
    REAGENT_VOL = 10   # treatment OR vehicle added per well
    MOAT_VOL = 10      # buffer per non-experimental well (4 wells/tip)
    MIX_VOL = 15       # mixing volume after reagent addition
    MIX_REPS = 3

    # ---- plate layout ----------------------------------------------------
    rows = "ABCDEFGH"
    all_wells = [f"{r}{c}" for r in rows for c in range(1, 13)]
    inner_wells = [f"{r}{c}" for r in "BCDEFG" for c in range(2, 12)]  # 6x10 = 60

    # Balanced, randomized group assignment: 24 treatment / 24 control
    shuffled = inner_wells[:]
    random.shuffle(shuffled)
    treatment_wells = sorted(shuffled[:24])
    control_wells = sorted(set(inner_wells) - set(treatment_wells))
    assert len(treatment_wells) == len(control_wells) == 24
    assert not (set(treatment_wells) & set(control_wells)), "Groups must not overlap"

    # All remaining wells get buffer (edge moat + humidity uniformity)
    experimental = set(treatment_wells) | set(control_wells)
    buffer_wells = [w for w in all_wells if w not in experimental]  # 60 wells

    samples = [f"{r}{c}" for r in "ABCD" for c in range(1, 7)]

    ]

    tip_keys = [f"{r}{c}" for r in rows for c in range(1, 13)]
    tip_index = 0
    expected_tips = 15 + 24 + 48  # moat + samples + reagent additions
    assert expected_tips <= len(tip_keys), "Not enough tips for this design"

    def fresh_tip():
        nonlocal tip_index
        key = tip_keys[tip_index]
        tip_index += 1
        return tip_rack[key]

    # ==================================================================
    # PHASE 1 - Buffer fill of all non-experimental wells
    #           (edge moat + humidity uniformity; confounder #1)
    # ==================================================================
    print("Phase 1: filling non-experimental wells with buffer moat ...")
    for i in range(0, len(buffer_wells), 4):
        batch = buffer_wells[i:i + 4]           # 4 wells per 40 uL tipful
        await lh.pick_up_tips(fresh_tip())
        await lh.aspirate(trough[BUFFER_CH], vols=[MOAT_VOL * len(batch)])
        for well in batch:
            await lh.dispense(dest_plate[well], vols=[MOAT_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()

    # ==================================================================
    # PHASE 2 - Plate samples in randomized order (paired design)
    # One tip per sample; it dispenses ONLY into that sample's own
    # treatment/control pair -> no cross-sample carry-over.
    # ==================================================================
    print("Phase 2: plating samples (randomized order) ...")
    for src, t_well, c_well in sample_plan:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(fresh_tip())
        await lh.aspirate(source_plate[src], vols=[SAMPLE_VOL * 2])
        await lh.dispense(dest_plate[t_well], vols=[SAMPLE_VOL])
        await lh.dispense(dest_plate[c_well], vols=[SAMPLE_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()  # discard: tip touched two wells

    # PHASE 3 - Treatment / vehicle addition (randomized, interleaved)
    # Fresh tip per well; dispense then mix in place; tip discarded so
    # nothing that entered an experimental well is ever reused.
    # ==================================================================
    print("Phase 3: adding treatment/vehicle (randomized, interleaved) ...")
    reagent_plan = (
        [(w, TREATMENT_CH, "T") for w in treatment_wells]
        + [(w, VEHICLE_CH, "C") for w in control_wells]
    )

    MIX_REPS = 3

    # ==================================================================

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Independent variable : TREATMENT (factor with 2 levels)
    #   * Treatment group  : sample + treatment reagent (trough A1)
    #   * Control group    : sample + vehicle solvent   (trough A2)

    #      to the inner 6x10 region (rows B-G, cols 2-11).
    #   2. Spatial bias  -> treatment/control assignment randomized
    #      (seeded, reproducible) across the plate.
    #   3. Order/time bias -> every phase processed in randomized order;

    #      experience identical timing drift.

    #      a sample tip only touches its own well pair; no tip ever
    #      enters both a treatment and a control well.
    #   5. Volume variability -> fixed, identical volumes in both groups.
    #   6. Row/block gradients -> rows act as blocks; both groups are
    #      present across the inner region.
    # ==================================================================
    import random

    random.seed(42)  # reproducible randomization

    # ---- resource handles ---------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    TREATMENT_CH = "A1"   # treatment reagent (factor level 1)
    VEHICLE_CH = "A2"     # vehicle control   (factor level 2)
    BUFFER_CH = "A3"      # blank buffer for moat / humidity wells

    SAMPLE_VOL = 15    # sample plated into every experimental well

    MOAT_VOL = 10      # buffer per non-experimental well (4 wells/tip)
    MIX_VOL = 15       # mixing volume after reagent addition
    MIX_REPS = 3

    rows = "ABCDEFGH"
    all_wells = [f"{r}{c}" for r in rows for c in range(1, 13)]
    inner_wells = [f"{r}{c}" for r in "BCDEFG" for c in range(2, 12)]  # 6x10 = 60

    shuffled = inner_wells[:]

    control_wells = sorted(set(inner_wells) - set(treatment_wells))
    assert len(treatment_wells) == len(control_wells) == 24

    experimental = set(treatment_wells) | set(control_wells)
    buffer_wells = [w for w in all_wells if w not in experimental]  # 60 wells

    ]

    tip_keys = [f"{r}{c}" for r in rows for c in range(1, 13)]
    tip_index = 0
    expected_tips = 15 + 24 + 48  # moat + samples + reagent additions
    assert expected_tips <= len(tip_keys), "Not enough tips for this design"

    def fresh_tip():
        nonlocal tip_index
        key = tip_keys[tip_index]
        tip_index += 1
        return tip_rack[key]

    # ==================================================================
    # PHASE 1 - Buffer fill of all non-experimental wells
    #           (edge moat + humidity uniformity; confounder #1)
    # ==================================================================
    print("Phase 1: filling non-experimental wells with buffer moat ...")
    for i in range(0, len(buffer_wells), 4):
        batch = buffer_wells[i:i + 4]           # 4 wells per 40 uL tipful
        await lh.pick_up_tips(fresh_tip())
        await lh.aspirate(trough[BUFFER_CH], vols=[MOAT_VOL * len(batch)])
        for well in batch:
            await lh.dispense(dest_plate[well], vols=[MOAT_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()

    # ==================================================================
    # PHASE 2 - Plate samples in randomized order (paired design)
    # One tip per sample; it dispenses ONLY into that sample's own
    # treatment/control pair -> no cross-sample carry-over.
    # ==================================================================

        await lh.pick_up_tips(fresh_tip())
        await lh.aspirate(source_plate[src], vols=[SAMPLE_VOL * 2])

    # Fresh tip per well; dispense then mix in place; tip discarded so
    # nothing that entered an experimental well is ever reused.
    # ==================================================================
    print("Phase 3: adding treatment/vehicle (randomized, interleaved) ...")
    reagent_plan = (
        [(w, TREATMENT_CH, "T") for w in treatment_wells]
        + [(w, VEHICLE_CH, "C") for w in control_wells]
    )

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

        f"{row}{col}"

    ]

          f"({len(declared_exclusions)} wells excluded: "

            await lh.dispense(primary_dest, vols=[TRANSFER_VOL])

            await lh.aspirate(source_plate[well], vols=[TRANSFER_VOL])
